description: This file defines an interface (IEquation) for graphing equations, including methods for retrieving options, IDs, and selection status.

classes.name: IEquation
classes.description: An interface for graphing equations, providing methods to access equation options, IDs, and selection status.

methods.name: GetGraphEquationOptions
methods.description: Returns the options associated with the graphing equation.

methods.name: GetGraphEquationID
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the graphing equation.

methods.name: TrySelectEquation
methods.description: Attempts to select the equation, returning true if successful.

methods.name: IsEquationSelected
methods.description: Checks if the equation is currently selected.
